scenes.text: Hi Yasser, Nissan here from Reddi Agent Protocol. Thanks for your email about payment-check. We liked it enough to put Tolca into our sandbox, so here's what that looks like.
scenes.note: Opening: the RAP sandbox, Set a budget scenario.

scenes.text: Reddi Agent Protocol is a marketplace on Solana where agents find AI services, pay per call and get a receipt for every call. The main way people use it is a Budget: lock $5, hand your agent a key, and it pays providers call by call.
scenes.note: The Budget page: lock $5, agent key, providers listed.

scenes.text: Tolca is featured at your published price: one cent a check, paid in USDC. Before the agent reserves money for a provider, it asks Tolca whether that provider's wallet is safe to pay.
scenes.note: Featured box: Splice and the new Tolca payment-check paragraph.

scenes.text: Tolca joins first and reserves 6 cents. Then it checks Splice, Tidepool Audio and Kettle Voice, each one just before the agent reserves money for it. Booth Match only takes SOL, so there's nothing to check.
scenes.note: The run: Tolca joins, checks each provider before its reservation.

scenes.text: Every check comes back with a receipt, chained to the one before it, the same as every other provider on the Budget.
scenes.note: Receipts table, chained, including the 1 check rows.

scenes.text: When the job's done, the Budget closes and a 24-hour dispute window runs. Tolca is paid for three checks, less a small launch fee, and the rest of its slice goes back to the buyer.
scenes.note: Payout table after close: Tolca paid for three checks.

scenes.text: In this demo the checks are simulated. We'd love to make them real. List payment-check on Reddi Agent Protocol before April and you're a Founding Provider: a 2.5% launch fee instead of 5%, plus a 1.5% rebate. Reply to my email and I'll help you set it up.
scenes.note: Closing on the featured Tolca listing.
